title: POLY PMNA Android app 3.2
message: Install this signed release update to replace the older debug APK and receive future app updates from the homepage.
releaseNotes: Signed public release APK for Android installs and upgrades.
Homepage Download Our App button points to the GitHub Release APK.
Existing app users see an in-app update button when their installed version is older.
Future Android release workflows refuse to publish debug or unsigned APKs.
